Resolves #18314

The Demo B whitebox test now proves the deployed Neural Link transaction path uses one dock Group cursor. It stages two moves, commits one row, lists and saves that row, then undoes, redoes and replays it through the public tools. It checks an unknown Group refusal and verifies the legacy writer stack stays separate. The Group implementation was delivered in earlier merged PRs; this test closes the reopened transport evidence gap.

Related: #18303

Evidence: L3 (real Chrome, live Neural Link Bridge, and Brain `fa390b6` transaction tools on this branch) → L3 required (AC-2 deployed Group commands). No residuals.
